latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of gray-matter skill:

- Parse YAML/JSON/TOML/CSON/CoffeeScript front-matter from strings or files using gray-matter.
- Provides a command-line script for extracting, adding, or stripping front-matter in markdown documents.
- Supports custom delimiters, piped input, and output customization (metadata only, content only, excerpt).
- Allows detection of front-matter presence and conversion between front-matter and JSON.
- TOML support via optional extra installation and integration instructions.
- Auto-installs gray-matter dependency on first script use.
